# telnyx_rooms (Data Source)

Lists rooms, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_room`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_date_created_at` (String) ISO 8601 date for filtering rooms created on that date.
- `filter_date_created_at_gte` (String) ISO 8601 date for filtering rooms created on or after that date.
- `filter_date_created_at_lte` (String) ISO 8601 date for filtering rooms created on or before that date.
- `filter_date_updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 date for filtering rooms updated on that date.
- `filter_date_updated_at_gte` (String) ISO 8601 date for filtering rooms updated on or after that date.
- `filter_date_updated_at_lte` (String) ISO 8601 date for filtering rooms updated on or before that date.
- `filter_unique_name` (String) Unique_name for filtering rooms.
- `include_sessions` (Boolean)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `rooms` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rooms))

<a id="nestedatt--rooms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rooms`

Read-Only:

- `active_session_id` (String) The identifier of the active room session if any.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the room was created.
- `enable_recording` (Boolean) Enable or disable recording for that room.
- `id` (String) A unique identifier for the room.
- `max_participants` (Number) Maximum participants allowed in the room.
- `record_type` (String)
- `sessions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rooms--sessions))
- `unique_name` (String) The unique (within the Telnyx account scope) name of the room.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the room was updated.
- `webhook_event_failover_url` (String) The failover URL where webhooks related to this room will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.
- `webhook_event_url` (String) The URL where webhooks related to this room will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.
- `webhook_timeout_secs` (Number) Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.

<a id="nestedatt--rooms--sessions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rooms.sessions`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Shows if the room session is active or not.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the room session was created.
- `ended_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the room session has ended.
- `id` (String) A unique identifier for the room session.
- `participants` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rooms--sessions--participants))
- `record_type` (String)
- `room_id` (String) Identify the room hosting that room session.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the room session was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--rooms--sessions--participants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rooms.sessions.participants`

Read-Only:

- `context` (String) Context provided to the given participant through the client SDK
- `id` (String) A unique identifier for the room participant.
- `joined_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the participant joined the session.
- `left_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the participant left the session.
- `record_type` (String)
- `session_id` (String) Identify the room session that participant is part of.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the participant was updated.
